en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.356 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said: "If I had reached Ikrimah at the time of his death, I would have benefited him."

When asked how, Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) explained:
"He would have instructed him in what you are upon (referring to the beliefs of faithful)”.
